subject: Access request for Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (NDA gating)
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@acmehealth.com
Date: 2025-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Access to Redwood SOC 2 Type II report

Hi Connor,

Hope you're well. Acme HealthTech is evaluating Redwood for a pilot and our security team needs to review your SOC 2 Type II report. Our security policy requires an executed NDA before we accept the report — is that acceptable?

A couple quick questions so we can plan:
- Can you confirm the audit period covered by the most recent SOC 2 Type II?
- Do you provide bridge letters when the report's audit end date doesn't cover our procurement window?
- How do you typically deliver the report (secure link, portal, SSO access)?

If NDA is required, please send your standard template or a DocuSign link and we'll route to legal. We aim to complete review within two weeks once we have the report.

Thanks — Jenna Park
Security Operations Manager
Acme HealthTech

Attachments: none
From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Access to Redwood SOC 2 Type II report

Hi Jenna — thanks for reaching out and glad to hear Acme HealthTech is evaluating Redwood.

Short answers up front:
- Our most recent SOC 2 Type II covers the period 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31.
- We gate sharing the full report behind an NDA; bridge letters are issued on a case-by-case basis (legal review).
- We deliver via a secure, time-limited download link after NDA execution.

I've attached our standard mutual NDA (Redwood_NDA_v2.pdf) and created a DocuSign envelope to speed things up: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/link/EXAMPLE-12345

Could you confirm the intended reviewers (names/emails) and whether Acme requires any specific countersignature language? If you prefer to send redlines, send them back and I'll loop in legal.

Best,
Connor Obrien
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_NDA_v2.pdf (PDF, 32KB)
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@acmehealth.com
Date: 2025-03-16T08:54:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Access to Redwood SOC 2 Type II report

Connor — thanks. We routed your NDA to our legal team and they returned a few redlines (see attached redlines_acme_legal.pdf).

Key asks from Acme legal:
- Clarify data return/destruction language for evaluation artifacts.
- Add standard mutual indemnity carveout for evaluation activities.

Can you provide a timeline for countersignature? Procurement is tracking this as part of the pilot kickoff and would appreciate a same-week turnaround if possible. Also, can you confirm that once NDA is executed we will receive a secure download link to the SOC 2 Type II PDF and a brief summary (one pager) of scope?

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-16T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Access to Redwood SOC 2 Type II report

Hi Jenna — looping in from Redwood legal. I reviewed Acme's redlines and we can accommodate the data-return language with one small clarification (we'll agree to destroy evaluation artifacts upon request, excluding aggregated telemetry required for product safety). We cannot accept the indemnity carveout as written, but we can offer a limited evaluation liability clause — I've attached a countersigned copy to this thread once executed.

Proposed next steps:
1) Connor will send an updated DocuSign with our limited evaluation liability language included.
2) Once DocuSign is completed by both parties we'll issue a secure download link to the SOC 2 Type II PDF and a one-page scope summary.
3) If Acme requests a formal bridge letter (to extend coverage past 2024-12-31), legal will review and advise — typically provided only when there is a short procurement gap.

We expect to complete countersignature within 24 business hours once redlines are accepted in DocuSign. Please confirm and we'll proceed.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (will upload signed NDA to the secure DocuSign envelope)
From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-18T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Access to Redwood SOC 2 Type II report

Jenna — thanks for your patience. DocuSign was completed this morning and legal has countersigned the agreement. We've generated a secure, time-limited download link for Acme's reviewers: https://secure.redwood.com/soc2/download/ACME-HT-2025-0043 (expires 2025-03-25). The package contains:

- SOC2_TypeII_2024-01-01_2024-12-31.pdf (full report)
- SOC2_Scope_Summary_1pager.pdf
- SOC2_Access_Instructions.txt (instructions for secure download and handling)

Per Priyom's note, if you require a formal bridge letter because your procurement window extends beyond 2025-03-25 please let us know the exact dates and reason for the request. We'll have legal evaluate and respond, but typically a bridge letter is only issued for short gaps (<=90 days) and subject to additional terms.

Confirmation request: please reply once your security reviewers have downloaded the package so we can close the ticket on our side.

Best regards,
Connor Obrien
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
